content: In this paper we presented a novel methodology for solving text-based games which first extracts high-performing trajectories using phase 1 of Go-Explore and then trains a simple Seq2Seq model that maps observations to actions using the extracted trajectories. Our experiments show promising results in three settings, with improved generalization and sample efficiency compared to existing methods. Finally, we discussed the limitations and possible improvements of our methodology, which leads to new research challenges in text-based games.
